content.question: Which dictionary covers Lamnso'?
content.answer: The Lamnso'-English Dictionary (Ngwà' Nsàv) by Karl Grebe and Patrick Siiyatan (2015), 825 pages, published by Rüdiger Köppe Verlag in the KWEF African Languages Monographs series. It is out of print and copyrighted.

content.answer: Not without permission from the publisher or compilers, because it is copyrighted.
